decisive_tests.test: All genuine required inputs must be sourced and bound to the same current case/actor. The speaker's own tenant/plaintiff security-deposit claim with hearing Oct9; the asking place is explicitly Woodbridge.

decisive_tests.when: Whenever chart analysis or a final answer is produced
decisive_tests.test: Use actual supplied native chart facts and a coherent contextual interpretation. Every decisive claim must link to the right role, rule and evidence; a citation alone or chart list is not reasoning. State relevant counter-testimony and unavailable evidence.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Current chart, actual native fact IDs/roles, checked worksheets and delivered prose; fine event order/stations/stars/antiscia require separate verification.

decisive_tests.when: A trial frame is resolved
decisive_tests.test: Compare the parties' accidental ability separately from essential dignity. Essential dignity describes justice of the case, not who necessarily wins.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Both main rulers, current essential/accidental facts and their roles.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Accidental strength can favor one party only until judge/verdict testimony overrides it.

decisive_tests.when: There is a relevant judge-to-party contact
decisive_tests.test: Read the judge's directed receptions toward both parties and combine preference with the applying contact; do not infer a winner from a generic good/bad judge label.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Judge position and dignity table, reception direction, applying/contact receipt.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: A verified contact plus preference can override the parties' strength balance.

decisive_tests.when: A winner is proposed
decisive_tests.test: Compare which party first reaches the verdict directly or through a valid translation/collection; judge-mediated translation must not disappear because it is indirect.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: All involved planet identities and certified order sufficient to distinguish competing verdict paths; printed pp.210–212.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: A first verified path to the verdict has priority; unresolved event order prevents a categorical winner.

decisive_tests.when: The parties apply to each other
decisive_tests.test: A conjunction can indicate settlement before court; another aspect can indicate agreement after opening but before verdict. Compare this path with the court/verdict paths.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Actual application, receptions, baseline hearing context and ordered contacts.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Settlement may answer the practical concern differently from winning a formal verdict.

decisive_tests.when: A financial benefit is mentioned
decisive_tests.test: Distinguish receiving a favorable ruling from actually benefiting financially. Use each party's money and the verdict's effects only where the chart supports them.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Relevant second-house rulers and verdict receptions/contacts; no invented award amount.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: A nominal win may still bring costs or an unsatisfying deposit recovery.

answer.must_address: Whether the actual plaintiff wins or obtains a useful settlement in the specified deposit dispute, with the decisive legal-process/verdict path explained. Case-specific concern: The speaker's own tenant/plaintiff security-deposit claim with hearing Oct9; the asking place is explicitly Woodbridge.
conditional_conclusions: A verified verdict path may favor the plaintiff or landlord despite who appears more justified.
A supported settlement path must be described as settlement rather than a completed court victory.
If the specialist boundary or third-party frame remains unresolved, clearly withhold the verdict; that is a blocked reading, not a successful interpretation.
answer.uncertainty: Do not turn the hearing date into the chart time. Close paths beyond the native coverage/order resolution require better calculation before a winner can be stated.

forbidden_inferences: Being in the right guarantees winning.
The ninth house represents the functioning court merely because the dispute concerns law.
A strong judge automatically favors the plaintiff.
An unheard claim, named brother, or generic chart can fill the missing party facts.
A favorable verdict guarantees a full exact refund.
No fixed yes/no outcome is authored before the actual chart exists.
Event/venue/date context cannot silently replace the understood-question reader anchor.
shared_recipe: Four-role adjudication: party ability → process preference/contact → first verdict path → settlement and practical cost.

decisive_tests.when: Moon applies to a candidate
decisive_tests.test: Give a verified electorate-to-candidate contact priority despite Moon's reception. If competing paths are unresolved or outside available coverage, withhold a categorical result.

decisive_tests.when: There is no verified Moon contact
decisive_tests.test: Consider Moon's receptions, then candidate condition and changes; receptions need not be decisive. Void Moon supports status quo only where there is a genuine incumbent/status quo.

decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: No short-range Moon path or absent king in an open race does not automatically elect either candidate.

decisive_tests.when: Condition is compared
decisive_tests.test: Essential dignity need not elect a good candidate. Use accidental strength, combustion and context-sensitive movement; entering one's own house can mean going home in defeat, and cazimi is not automatically becoming king.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Native candidate condition and role-specific contextual reading.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: A claim of victory must not depend merely on moral quality or a generic strength slogan.

decisive_tests.when: Neither candidate is incumbent
decisive_tests.test: A supported candidate-to-Lord10 path can indicate obtaining the unengaged office; avoid role collisions and fabricated contacts.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Distinct candidate/office roles and real application/translation if appropriate.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: This can favor a candidate when the source's open-office prerequisites hold.

decisive_tests.when: An incumbent unseating Part is cited
decisive_tests.test: Require an actual verified Part/dispositor calculation, not a fabricated number or assumption from the word incumbent.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Supplied Part calculation and checked conjunction/opposition; otherwise explicitly unavailable.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: An unavailable auxiliary Part cannot decide the outcome.

decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Wrong classification, unsourced facts or wrong actor block qualification even if a chart or fluent answer exists.

decisive_tests.when: Before attempting or scoring a completed reading
decisive_tests.test: Require actual completion of the implemented native reading workflow with current bound worksheets and final interpretation. Readiness or classification alone is not a reading.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Current executable contract coverage, task/checkpoint receipts, accepted current-revision worksheets and actual delivered judgment if available.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Incomplete or incorrectly bound workflow cannot qualify; completed structure still requires source judgment.

decisive_tests.when: Whenever chart analysis or a final answer is produced
decisive_tests.test: Use actual supplied native chart facts and a coherent contextual interpretation. Every decisive claim must link to the right role, rule and evidence; a citation alone or chart list is not reasoning. State relevant counter-testimony and unavailable evidence.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Current chart, actual native fact IDs/roles, checked worksheets and delivered prose; fine event order/stations/stars/antiscia require separate verification.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Fabricated testimony, wrong reception direction, absent interpretation or unsupported certainty fails the reading independent of valid serialization.

decisive_tests.when: A job reading begins
decisive_tests.test: Retain no offer and actual applicant. Wish/unclassified surface language must route to the disclosed external-job matter; do not keep an eleventh-house wish program.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Canonical job subject, no-offer state, applicant binding and supplied context.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Answering offer quality or the speaker's job when Alex is the applicant fails.

decisive_tests.when: Obtaining the job is judged
decisive_tests.test: Use an applicant-to-job path, including valid translation/collection, with motive/ability and impediments. Wages-to-applicant alone, or applicant merely in tenth, is not sufficient proof of getting it.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Correct applicant/job roles and actual ordered contact/reception/condition facts.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: A supported path can favor acquisition; isolated wage or desire testimony cannot.

decisive_tests.when: A path is assessed
decisive_tests.test: Judge applicant's ability and job/company capacity as well as reception. Ordinary jobs need not strongly love the applicant; even minor positive reception may matter, and dislike must be read with strength/context.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Native applicant/job essential and accidental condition and reception direction.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: A contact without ability or a simplistic demand for strong job affection is incomplete.

decisive_tests.when: Another candidate is claimed to win first
decisive_tests.test: Require a real justified rival role and actual earlier job-to-rival path; do not invent a competitor or infer temporal order from overlapping hourly brackets.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Actual identified/justified rival and sufficient contact-order receipt.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Competition can override acquisition only when the evidence supports it.

decisive_tests.when: The final answer is written
decisive_tests.test: Give a coherent answer to the librarian acquisition concern with the strongest support, counter-testimony and remaining limitations. Distinguish bad pay/job quality from not getting the job.
decisive_tests.required_evidence: Completed bound judgment plus cited role/condition/reception/contact facts.
decisive_tests.outcome_dependency: Chart lists or workflow promises alone do not deliver a reading.

answer.must_address: Whether the actual applicant obtains the interviewed-for librarian job, with an explicit event basis rather than a chart summary. Case-specific concern: Bare Alex name has no initial concern. After brother plus unoffered librarian interview disclosure route new_job/event with Alex3 and external job10.
conditional_conclusions: A supported applicant/job perfection path with capacity may favor getting the job.
Contrary ability/motive or a real earlier competing path can qualify or negate it.
A useful bounded situation interpretation is allowed where exact timing/outcome coverage is insufficient; do not fabricate a calendar result.
answer.uncertainty: Native positions are approximate and hourly contact brackets cover seven days. Missing candidates do not establish that no event can occur beyond the sampled interval; exact stations, fine event order, fixed stars and antiscia are not certified.

forbidden_inferences: An interview means an offer is already available.
A first-house wish automatically uses eleventh-house wish ruler.
Alex's new external job uses turned tenth merely because he is a brother.
A wages contact proves the job is obtained.
Applicant in tenth alone is a definite Yes.
A recruiter or rival can be invented to explain a contact.
No fixed yes/no outcome is authored before the actual chart exists.
Event/venue/date context cannot silently replace the understood-question reader anchor.
shared_recipe: External acquisition: actual applicant plus radical job10 → motive/ability → verified direct/indirect path → interpreted answer.
